items:
A work permit must be issued ,the maintenance staff should 
 be qualified and carry the suitable safety category .
Switch off all C.B s on the motor control center (M.C.C)

Select "DATA" list 16 , 
 logic forcing and enter logic signals L14HR, L14HM, L14HA and L14HS on the CRT 
 display

Slowly increase the oscillator frequency from zero and verify that the zero 
 speed logic L14HR resets to logic "0" at the dropout speed given in the 
 control spec. setting . adjust from constant TNK 14HR if dropout does not 
 occur at the correct speed .

Slowly decrease the oscillator frequency and verify that the zero speed logic 
 L14HR goes to a logic "1" at the pickup speed given in the control spec. 
 setting . adjust from constant TNK 14HR if correction is required .

Continue to increase the oscillator frequency and verify that all of the 
 other speed logic signals change to a logic "1" at the pickup speed listed in 
 the control spec. setting . adjust corresponding from constants listed if 
 required as shown in table(1) .

Slowly decrease the oscillator frequency from full speed and verify that all 
 of the speed logic signals resets to a logic "0" at the dropout speed listed 
 in the control spec. setting . adjust corresponding from constants listed if 
 required
